angular.formula: For each predeclared theta bin b, E_at(b)=sum_n dt[sum_{f in b}|Gamma_f|pi_at,f(U^n)/6 + sum_{f in b}|Gamma_f|pi_at,f(U^(1))/6 + 2sum_{f in b}|Gamma_f|pi_at,f(U^(2))/3]
angular.weighting: native face measure and SSP-RK3 weights at every accepted step

case8.face_scope: native x and y interior faces
case8.formula: sum_n dt[pi_at,front(U^n)/6 + pi_at,front(U^(1))/6 + 2*pi_at,front(U^(2))/3] / sum_n dt[pi_at,domain(U^n)/6 + pi_at,domain(U^(1))/6 + 2*pi_at,domain(U^(2))/3]
case8.spatial_scope: predeclared |x-x_s(y)| <= 0.08 front window / all Case8 interior faces
case8.weighting: native face measure dx/dy and SSP-RK3 weights (1/6,1/6,2/3) at every accepted step

cylinder.formula: sum_n dt[sum_{f in fixed_front} |Gamma_f| pi_at,f(U^n)/6 + sum_{f in fixed_front} |Gamma_f| pi_at,f(U^(1))/6 + 2*sum_{f in fixed_front} |Gamma_f| pi_at,f(U^(2))/3] / E_at,int(T)
cylinder.spatial_scope: predeclared A_u authoritative-front anchors with radial band +/-0.16 / all Cylinder interior faces
cylinder.weighting: native face measure and SSP-RK3 weights (1/6,1/6,2/3) at every accepted step
